use.flag: Embed the Japanese UI and Type-tool fonts from storytold/craft-fonts, like the official releases (otherwise the system's CJK fonts are used)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: PhotoCraft is a clean-room reimplementation of a Photoshop-style editor in pure Rust: layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and PSD/PSB round-tripping, rendered on the GPU (wgpu). Built from source; media-gfx/photocraft-bin installs the upstream release binary instead. Early alpha.
